info.title: Tray.ai Core API (baton-trayai surface)
info.description:
The subset of the Tray.ai Core v1 REST API that baton-trayai calls. Scope is derived from pkg/connector/client/client.go and pkg/connector/client/path.go; shapes are settled against Tray's published API reference (https://tray.ai/documentation/developer/openapi/trayapi/tag/users/ and .../tag/workspaces/, accessed 2026-09-17). Response schemas include only the properties the Go structs decode -- Tray returns more.

Auth is a bearer token (uhttp.NewBearerAuth in pkg/connector/connector.go:New). Reads send `Accept: application/json` and `Content-Type: application/json`; writes send `Accept: application/json` with a JSON body.

Pagination is cursor based: list operations send `cursor` (the previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`) and `first` (the SDK-supplied page size), and the sync stops when `pageInfo.hasNextPage` is false.

There is no credential-validation probe -- Connector.Validate is a no-op, so nothing is exercised until the first sync request.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Organization users and their organization role. Synced as user resources; also the account-provisioning surface.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Organization-level roles, synced as role resources with grants.

tags.name: Workspaces
tags.description: Workspaces, their roles, and their per-workspace user role assignments.

get.description: Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:ListUsers. Used by userBuilder.List, which reads only `elements[].id` and then calls getUser for each one, and by client.ListWorkspaceUsers when no workspace ID is supplied.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Exact-match email filter. Supported by client.ListParams but not currently set by any caller.

post.description: Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:CreateUser, behind userBuilder's account provisioning. Per Tray this endpoint does not send an invitation and is intended for SSO-configured organizations.

get.description: Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:GetOrganizationUser, and GetWorkspaceUser when the workspace ID is empty. Called once per user during the user sync, so it runs N+1 times against a page of listUsers.

delete.summary: Remove a user from the organization
delete.description: Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:RemoveOrganizationUser, used when revoking an organization role grant. The response body is not decoded.

put.description: Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:SetWorkspaceRole when the workspace ID is empty -- the organization-role branch of granting a role. The response body is not decoded.

get.description: Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:ListWorkspaceRoles when the workspace ID is empty. Source of the organization-level role resources; `elements[].id` and `elements[].name` are consumed.
Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:ListWorkspaces. Source of the workspace resources; `id`, `name`, `type`, `description`, and `monthlyTaskLimit` all land in the workspace resource profile.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Workspace type filter. Supported by client.ListParams (ListParams.WorkspaceType) but not currently set by any caller. Values are taken from the client comment, not from Tray's reference.

get.description: Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:GetWorkspace. Only `type` is consumed: the connector compares it to the literal `Organization` to decide whether a role is an organization role or a workspace role (pkg/connector/roles.go, pkg/connector/workspaces.go).
Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:ListWorkspaceRoles when a workspace ID is set. Each element becomes a per-workspace role entitlement; `id` and `name` are consumed.
Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:ListWorkspaceUsers. Only `elements[].id` is consumed; the connector then calls getWorkspaceUser per element to learn each user's role in that workspace.

post.summary: Add a user to a workspace with a role
post.description: Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:AddUserToWorkspace, used when granting a workspace role to a user who is not yet a workspace member. The response body is not decoded.

get.summary: Retrieve a user's membership in a workspace
get.description: Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:GetWorkspaceUser. Distinct from getUser because a user can hold different roles in different workspaces; the connector consumes `id` and `role.id` to emit the workspace role grants.

put.summary: Set a user's role in a workspace
put.description: Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:SetWorkspaceRole when a workspace ID is set. The response body is not decoded.

delete.summary: Remove a user from a workspace
delete.description: Client: pkg/connector/client/client.go:RemoveWorkspaceUser, used when revoking a workspace role grant. The response body is not decoded.

bearerAuth.description: Tray.ai API token from the `auth-token` config field, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque forward cursor. The connector passes the previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted on the first request.

First.name: first
First.description: Page size. The connector forwards the page size supplied by the Baton SDK and omits the parameter when that size is zero, leaving Tray's default in effect.

Last.name: last
Last.description: Backward page size. Supported by client.ListParams but not currently set by any caller.

UserId.name: userId
UserId.description: Tray user ID, as returned in `elements[].id` / `id`.

WorkspaceId.name: workspaceId
WorkspaceId.description: Tray workspace ID, as returned by listWorkspaces.

Empty.description: Empty body. The connector issues the request without a JSON response target and ignores the payload.

UnmodelledError.description: Error. The client registers no uhttp.WithErrorResponse target, so the body is discarded and uhttp maps the status code to a gRPC status; Tray's reference does not document an error envelope for these endpoints, so none is modelled here.

Element.description: Tray's generic list element (client.Element). The same shape is returned for users, roles, and workspaces; which properties are populated depends on the collection.

id.description: Used as the Baton resource ID, and as the lookup key for the per-item getUser / getWorkspaceUser calls.

name.description: Display name; also the entitlement display name for roles.

type.description: Workspace type for workspace elements. The connector compares this to the literal `Organization`; it is stored in the workspace profile as `workspace_type`.

description.description: Stored in the workspace profile as `workspace_description`.

monthlyTaskLimit.description: Stored in the workspace profile as `workspace_monthlyTaskLimit`.

Workspace.description: A single workspace (client.Workspace, structurally identical to Element).

endCursor.description: Becomes the connector's next page token.

hasNextPage.description: The connector stops paginating when this is false.

ListResponse.description: The envelope returned by every list operation (client.ListResp). Decoded as-is; the connector never flattens it.

id.description: Compared against the role component of a grant ID when reconciling grants.

name.description: Stored in the user profile as `role`.

User.description: A user as returned by the single-user endpoints (client.User). `workspaceId` is present only on the workspace-scoped variant.

id.description: Used as the Baton user resource ID.

email.description: Primary email of the user resource.

name.description: Display name and login. Documented on the organization-user response; Tray's reference omits it from the workspace-user response, where the connector does not read it.

accountType.description: Stored in the user profile as `accountType`.
